decision.reason: The user asked to cut rc.34 without a benchmark round so the release branch, which every plugin catalog installs from, carries the logo kit (#143), the problems-it-solves agent surfaces (#142) and MCP icons before Tracetoon is submitted to those catalogs. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
